name: zest
description: Zest for Codex — track sessions for standups and workflow insights

interface.shortDescription: Zest for Codex — track sessions for standups and workflow insights
interface.longDescription: Zest collects your own Codex session data locally, applies privacy redaction, and syncs it to your personal Zest workspace so you can generate standups and review your own workflow insights. Remote upload is user-controlled.
interface.defaultPrompt: Log me into Zest so this Codex workspace is ready to sync my sessions.
